name: PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri Tbk
summary: PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri Tbk manufactures, distributes, and sells porcelain tiles and granites under the Essenza brand in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Ceramic and Hotel. The company engages in the hospitality business; and leasing of building units. PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri Tbk was founded in 1991 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
